claim_scores.rationale: Uses `dspy.Signature(...)` with string signatures and no `custom_types`; all custom names are bound in the same caller-visible local scope inside `build()`.
Defines function-local `LocalType` as a `pydantic.BaseModel`, builds a string signature with `LocalType`, and asserts the resolved annotation is that class.
Defines nested `Box.Inner` as a `pydantic.BaseModel`, uses dotted `Box.Inner` in the signature, and asserts the annotation resolves to `Box.Inner`.
Binds `Alias = Box.Inner`, uses `Alias` in the signature, and asserts the annotation resolves to that alias target.
Tries unqualified `Inner`, expects failure, and captures the `ValueError`, proving the unbound nested name does not resolve.
